Add Heatmap Annotation to a Phylogenetic Tree

tree_annotate.Rd

Add Heatmap Annotation to a Phylogenetic Tree

Usage

tree_annotate(
  p,
  hm_data,
  hm_layout = list(offset = 0.01, width = 0.1),
  hm_args = list(),
  palette = NULL,
  palette_mapping = NULL,
  contrast_factor = 0
)

Arguments

p

A ggtree plot object.

hm_data

A data.frame or tibble containing annotation columns indexed by tip label.

hm_layout

Named list specifying offset and width passed to ggtree::gheatmap(). Default is list(offset = 0.01, width = 0.1).

hm_args

Named list. Additional styling arguments passed to ggtree::gheatmap(). Default is list().

palette

Character vector of colors, or a list of character vectors for multiple palettes. Default is NULL.

palette_mapping

Named vector or list mapping column names of hm_data to indices or names in palette. Default is NULL.

contrast_factor

Numeric. Brightness adjustment factor passed to zhutilsr::.adjust_palette_brightness(). Default is 0.

Value

A ggtree plot object with the heatmap annotation layer added.

See also
